_: Inkling-2-Mini (thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, 26B: 24 layers, layers 6..17 run three times) on maya-ik2 (src/ik2, docs/INKLING2.md section 8), an experimental preview: unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL GGUF at the repo's top - Unsloth's looped layout (general.architecture inkling2: inkling2.num_loops, inkling2.loop.core_start), which maya-ik2 reads; the files in Mainline_Support/ (inkling2_loop, llama.cpp master's) are not offered. Experts of layers 0-19 NVFP4 (their original bits), layers 20-23 and the dense weights Q8_0. The drafter: "drafter" below (thinkingmachines' own, drafting auto by default). The file pinned by revision, size and sha256: the setup checks them.
name: Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q4_K_XL
about: UD-Q4_K_XL: NVFP4 experts in layers 0-19, Q8_0 elsewhere; 26B parameters, 8 of 128 experts a token

vision._: The pictures: unsloth's mmproj of the model's vision tower (llama.cpp's inkling2v projector, BF16), from the same repo and revision, read by maya-vision (tools/vision/inkling2v_patch.py) when a picture arrives; not with --no-vision.

drafter._: Drafting: thinkingmachines' own drafter of Inkling-2-Mini (mtp.safetensors, a DSpark-style draft model, BF16; Apache 2.0) from the model's repo at a pinned revision, read by maya-ik2 --draft; not with --drafting off. With --drafting auto the engine measures once on the PC whether it (or the prompt lookup) makes answers faster, and drafting never changes the answers.
